description: Reads .env (via python-dotenv) and the process environment, resolves filesystem paths absolutely, and constructs a Settings instance. Missing STEAM_WEB_API_KEY is not fatal here; it is validated lazily by the acquisition client that first needs it.
signature: def load_settings(env_path: Path | None = None) -> Settings
docstring:
Load environment-derived settings.

Args:
    env_path: Explicit path to a .env file. If None, python-dotenv's default discovery (cwd and parents) is used. Tests always pass an explicit fixture path so discovery never touches a developer's real .env.

Returns:
    A populated, frozen Settings instance with all paths resolved to absolute pathlib.Path objects.

Raises:
    ValueError: If STEAM_ANALYST_DB_PATH or STEAM_ANALYST_PARAMETERS_PATH resolve to a value that is not a valid path string, or if http_timeout_seconds (from STEAM_ANALYST_HTTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, default '30') cannot be parsed as a positive float.
preconditions: If env_path is given, the caller is responsible for it existing; a missing env_path file is not an error (dotenv silently no-ops), consistent with .env being optional in production
postconditions: Settings.db_path and Settings.parameters_path are absolute paths regardless of whether the corresponding environment variable was relative
Settings.steam_web_api_key is None whenever the environment variable is unset or set to an empty string

edge_cases.input: env_path=None and no .env file discoverable anywhere
edge_cases.expected_behavior: falls back to process environment / documented defaults; does not raise
raises ValueError naming the offending variable
resolved against the current working directory into an absolute Path

unit_tests.name: test_load_settings_from_fixture_env_file
unit_tests.description: A fixture .env with all variables set produces a Settings instance with matching, absolute-path fields.

unit_tests.name: test_missing_api_key_is_not_fatal
unit_tests.description: A fixture .env without STEAM_WEB_API_KEY still returns a Settings instance, with steam_web_api_key=None.

unit_tests.name: test_invalid_timeout_raises
unit_tests.description: A malformed timeout value raises ValueError.
